Bull.story: Management's plan arrives: the $6B of synergies land in full, the Paramount+/HBO Max bundle lifts ARPU toward peers (DTC +10% a year at a 23% margin) and linear shrinks only 4.5% a year. Adjusted EBITDA ≈$19B (24% margin), FCF ≈$9.5B in 2031, net leverage ≈2.8×, warrants exercised. FY2031 owner FCF per share × 12 (≈8.5× EV/EBITDA).

Base.story: Synergies mostly arrive, but linear revenue falls 6% a year and eats about half of them, as at WBD after 2022. DTC grows 7% a year to a 19% margin. Adjusted EBITDA ≈$14.6B (21%), FCF ≈$5B, net leverage ≈4.9× in 2031, so the 3× target slips. FY2031 owner FCF per share × 10 (≈7.9× EV/EBITDA).

Bear.story: Linear falls 9% a year as sports and carriage renewals reset, the bundle fails to lift ARPU and synergies are spent defending share. Adjusted EBITDA ≈$10B, leverage above the 5.5× covenant, the dividend is cut and equity is raised (+4% shares a year); refinancing $20B of maturities keeps interest near $6B. FY2031 owner FCF per share × 8 (≈7.7× EV/EBITDA, generous for this case) stands in for the option value of a 7×-levered equity.
